name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Scrollable Material tabs with the stretching underline indicator, fixed-width and transparent styles.
improvements: The indicator is measured with a ResizeObserver, so it stays aligned with scrollbars, on resize, after fonts load, inside modals and collapsibles, and when first rendered hidden.
Correct indicator position in right-to-left layouts (set dir="rtl").
Full WAI-ARIA tabs pattern from Radix: roving focus, arrow keys, Home/End, automatic or manual activation.
The active tab is scrolled into view inside the tab strip without scrolling the page.
Inactive labels meet WCAG AA contrast, and keyboard focus is clearly visible.
Controlled and uncontrolled value with onValueChange.
